info.title: IPS · API de la consulta externa
info.description: Agendamiento, admisión, consulta médica y farmacia. Todas las rutas, salvo /health y el webhook de Clerk, exigen `Authorization: Bearer <token de sesión de Clerk>` y viven bajo `/teams/{teamId}` (la IPS).

bearer.description: Token de sesión de Clerk, sin la palabra Bearer.

team.name: X-Team-Id
team.description: Id de la IPS (org_…). Rellena {teamId} en todas las rutas; la API no lo lee.

BoardCall.description: One call shown on the waiting-room screen (no document, no full name).

current.description: The latest turn being announced, shown large.

recent.description: The previous calls, most recent first.

CompanionView.description: One companion of the patient's history; `number` grows with each one.

bmi.description: Body mass index, when weight and height were measured.

principal.description: Exactly one diagnosis is the main one (principal) to sign.

MovementReference.description: Why stock moved: what the kardex shows.

MyAccessView.description: What the caller may do in an IPS (for the UI to show only that).

NoteProps.description: What the physician writes (free text; empty until filled in).

PharmacyPrescriptionView.description: A signed prescription (as the pharmacy may see it) and what was delivered of it.

available.description: Units that can be dispensed (not expired).

expired.description: Units in expired lots, to write off.

ProductView.description: A catalog product with its stock as of today (Colombia).

appointment.description: The active appointment holding the slot, if any.

roles.description: Functional roles assigned by the IPS administrators.

StaffMemberView.description: A member of an IPS, as shown to the other members (no full e-mail).

requestedByName.description: From the staff directory at read time; null when unknown.

origin.description: Waiting for an appointment, or to pick up a prescription at the pharmacy.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body. `code` is a machine-readable domain error (see technical-api/errors.md); shape errors have none.
